outcome: abundance of specific bacterial profiles (Gram-negative alpha-proteobacteria and Gram-positive Bacilli)
cohort: 328 children from an at-risk birth cohort (COPSAC2000) were included in this study.
finding: Season of birth was significantly associated with nasopharyngeal bacterial richness at 1-month of age, with summer-born children displaying higher bacterial richness and more abundant specific bacterial profiles.
